note: The trigger cases of the three skills of this host (F113-FR-038): six positive and six negative cases per skill, with the confusable pair run and reverse among them. A case carries a prompt, a kind (positive, negative, cross-skill) and the expected skill or none. NO file here holds a model id (F113-FR-039): the model of a run comes from the configuration of the run, given by the person who starts it. A run of the suite calls a model and is a paid task: a person starts it, no job of the build starts it, and it is logged (assumption CQ-188). The graders are the free graders of graders.json; no ablation exists.
